# Aurora Coworking Ljubljana

> Community-run coworking space at Železna cesta 14 (level 1), 1000 Ljubljana, Slovenia, close to the bus and train stations. Part of Aurora Coworking, Slovenia's oldest coworking network. Two memberships: Fixed (180€ + VAT) and Flex (120€ + VAT), both with 24/7 access and meeting rooms.

## Pages

- [Aurora Coworking Ljubljana](https://lj.auroracoworking.com/index.md): the whole page as Markdown: location, approach, memberships and prices, members, contact.
